text:
## Distribution & Acknowledgment  
**Distribution:**
- Email to all staff
- Posted on staff intranet
- Printed copies in branch staff rooms
- Included in monthly staff meetings  
**Acknowledgment:**
- Staff must read and sign acknowledgment
- Training sessions held for key bulletins
- Quiz/assessment for important updates
- Failure to acknowledge = record in file
